pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Polygonal to sub-rectangular dark regions with smooth to slightly jagged edge gradients. Patches on the mid-flank are larger in spatial area compared to the smaller, more densely packed patches on the hindquarters.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Interconnecting light-colored pathways forming a continuous topological graph. Junctions primarily consist of tri- and quadri-point intersections. Pixel thickness is narrowest on the dorsal ridge and widens slightly on the mid-flank.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: The mane displays a high-frequency, low-amplitude serrated profile along the upper neck and shoulder. The hair-tips create a jagged silhouette against the background.
